text.tspan: Share of potential polio cases tested and reported to the WHO
The share of acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases for which stool was collected, tested for poliovirus and reported
Note: The WHO recommends that the adequate stool collection rate should be at least 80% to ensure that suspected cases are being tested
